end.parentNote: Diya practised matching 4-digit number words to numerals using place-value boxes. They explained that “forty-two” has 4 tens and 2 ones, but the empty hundreds place in 6042 was still a mix-up at the end. At home, practise a few numbers with zero places, such as 4050 and 6042, by saying each place aloud before writing.
